name: pmx (Proxmox CLI)
description: Installs the pmx Proxmox CLI (VE / Backup Server / Datacenter Manager) via eget from fivetwenty-io/proxmox-cli release binaries.

version.description: pmx release tag to install (e.g. v0.6.1). Use 'latest' for the newest GitHub release. Bare semver (0.6.1) is accepted and normalized to v0.6.1.
